timeline.text: A new update for the app would sit on the phone every night, waiting for a tap that never came.
So the app quietly fell behind, missing whatever each update had fixed.
Now it checks for a newer build itself, after every drive, and downloads it.
It verifies the version, then installs through Android's PackageInstaller — no tap needed.
It never interrupts a drive — closing a gap that once ran two versions deep.
